story.pitch: What his posts did, in their own numbers: the article 304万 read, then the nine months of 《自媒体很苦》 that came to 46K粉 and 变现7W

seen.opening: his X page floats as glass slabs; his picture peels off like a sticker and puffs into his mascot, which pushes its 3D glasses
beats: he stomps the pinned post; its cover stands up as a wall, and 304万 阅读 lifts out of the post and counts up
the cover of 《自媒体很苦》 stands up as a wall; its boxes push out (9个月, 46K粉, 变现7W) and he climbs them, then becomes the drawing of himself on that cover
seen.ending: his 公众号 mark grows a snail under it (the mark is its shell); he rides it while torn-paper labels slap down: 公众号变现 | 找蜗牛

story.pitch: A newcomer who thought of it first: an official SpaceXAI ambassador, the first to chat with Grok bot on 微信, 10,000 followers in one month and 18 days

seen.opening: his X page fills the frame flat like a screen, turns and parts into standing slabs; his cat's photo bulges and the calico puffs out of it
beats: a gold medal drops round the cat's neck; labels slap up: SpaceXAI 官方认证大使, and the stamp 中国区
a phone with his real first chat with Grok bot on 微信; the bot hops out of the screen as a toy; his article rises and 155万 浏览 counts up
the cat hops up a rising bar chart while the days and the followers run to 10000 粉丝; a 破万! stamp and confetti
seen.ending: three Grok bots (orange, black, purple) drop in round the cat; 想学 Grok bot | 找 Kin 进群; it beckons like a lucky cat

story.pitch: From a wild fan to the official one: 10,000 followers by 10月24日, his Grok App at 1,500 stars, and 野生大使 turned 官方认证

seen.opening: his X page fills the frame flat like a screen, turns and parts into standing slabs; his picture bulges and he puffs out of it
beats: a desk calendar flips from 7月10日 to 10月24日 while the count climbs to 10,000; a red 万粉 stamp slams on
the cover of his Grok App post stands up as a wall; he points at 380, which turns into gold digits counting to 1,500 stars
野生大使 on his head; the invitation flies in as an envelope, a red 官方认证 seal slaps on and 野生 bursts off
马斯克得不到的男人 rises a letter at a time; he kicks the red 不 out
seen.ending: he lands on a white Grok Bot ball and rolls it; the lines slap down and he points at you
seen.sound: the effects over a quiet layer of long chords
